en.headline: Police treat Shek Kong road incident as criminal damage after object thrown at car
en.dek: A 19-year-old driver reported that a man in black threw a hard object at his BMW near Route Twisk around 1am on Monday; officers are seeking the man.
body: Police are treating an early Monday incident near Shek Kong as criminal damage after a 19-year-old driver said a man dressed in black threw a hard object at his BMW as it travelled along Route Twisk.

The driver, who was with his girlfriend, told officers he was heading home at normal speed around 1am with no prior interaction with the individual. Dashcam footage is understood to show the object striking the vehicle on a bend. The driver said he slowed and questioned the man in English before the man vaulted a barrier and moved towards the car while challenging him, prompting the couple to leave the scene and call police.

A preliminary check found a dented bonnet and damage to a window, with repair costs estimated at about HK$15,000. The driver said he expected the damage would not be covered by insurance. Police said the Yuen Long Criminal Investigation Team is following up, seeking a man in black clothing, and reviewing available footage to establish the sequence of events.

zh.headline: 石崗荃錦公路有人向私家車擲物 警列刑事毀壞跟進
zh.dek: 19歲司機指周一凌晨約時有黑衣男子向其寶馬擲硬物，警方正尋找涉事男子。
body: 警方正以刑事毀壞調查石崗附近一宗事件。一名19歲司機報稱，周一凌晨約1時沿荃錦公路行駛時，有黑衣男子從路邊草叢擲硬物擊中其寶馬。
司機與其女友同行，指當時以正常速度回家，與該男子並無事先接觸。網上片段顯示物件擊中車輚的一刻。司機稱減速後以英語質問對方，該男子隨即越過欄杆向車輚走近並大聲挑戰，兩人為安全離開現場並報警。
初步檢查發現車頭蓋凹陷及車窗損壞，維修費用估計約1.5萬港元。司機指相信保險不涵蓋有關損失。警方表示元朗刑事調查隊正跟進，尋找黑衣男子，並檢視片段以釐清事件經過。
